result.instructions: Tools for EstatePrime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which active listings are for sale in my account?"; "Show me the open tasks due this week and who they are assigned to."; "Find the contact with id 1489 and list their phones and emails.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes EstatePrime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run estateprime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run estateprime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run estateprime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. estateprime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: estateprime_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: Lists property listings, one page at a time, with optional status, availability and category filters. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/listings.

tools.name: estateprime_get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: Gets one property listing by id, with its location, photos, details and translations. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/listings/{id}.

tools.name: estateprime_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts (clients, leads and owners), one page at a time. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/contacts.

tools.name: estateprime_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Gets one contact by id, with phones, emails, address, custom fields and linked contact details. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: estateprime_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks, one page at a time, optionally filtered by status id. Deleted tasks are never returned. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/tasks.

status_id.description: Only tasks with this status id (see the account's task statuses).

tools.name: estateprime_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Gets one task by id, with its users, contacts and tags. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: estateprime_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Creates a new task assigned to one or more users. Writes a new record in the CRM. EstatePrime API: POST /api/tasks.

created_by.description: User id of the task creator (an active user).

users.description: User ids to assign the task to (at least one).

contacts.description: Contact ids to link to the task.

tools.name: estateprime_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: Lists users (agents and staff), one page at a time. Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/users.

tools.name: estateprime_list_usergroups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: Lists the user group names (for example Admin and Agent). Read-only. EstatePrime API: GET /api/users/usergroups.
